records.failureSummary: Implemented and wired the two escaping helpers in src/render.mjs. escapeHtmlText performs a single-pass regex replace of &, <, >, " and ' with &, <, >, " and ' (no double-escaping); escapeAttributeUrl replaces only & with & and " with ", leaving /, ?, =, :, # and all other URL characters verbatim. Both helpers coerce null/undefined to an empty string and return new strings without mutating input. escapeHtmlText is applied to the page title, headings, paragraph text and link text; escapeAttributeUrl is applied only to the href URL. renderPage returns a complete HTML document with the escaped title in both <title> and <h1>, and renderMarkdownLite applies headings, then paragraph grouping (single-space join), then inline link conversion. Only src/render.mjs changed; src/frontmatter.mjs and src/build.mjs were left untouched. npm run build and npm run lint pass; the renderPage test passes. The remaining test failure is buildSite not implemented in src/build.mjs, which is owned by a separate build task outside this slice.
